# uptrace_org_member (Data Source)

Reads one person's membership of an organization by the email address: `active` for a member, `pending` while an invitation waits. Use it to get the `org_user_id` of a member that this configuration does not manage, such as the provider's own account, which owns each organization it creates. The read fails when the address has no membership and no live invitation, and for a membership that an SSO provider is bound to, which is not read by email. Requires org admin. Requires an app version that serves `/internal/v1/orgs/{org_id}/members/by-email`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptrace_org" "main" {
  name = "Main"
}

# The membership of the person at alice@example.com: active, with an
# org_user_id, or pending while an invitation waits.
data "uptrace_org_member" "alice" {
  org_id = uptrace_org.main.id
  email  = "alice@example.com"
}

output "alice_org_user_id" {
  value = data.uptrace_org_member.alice.org_user_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The person's email address, lowercase and trimmed.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<org_id>:<email>`.
- `org_user_id` (String) The org user ID of an active membership, for an `org_user_id` such as that of `uptrace_team_user`. Null while the membership is pending.
- `role` (String) Organization role: owner, admin, member, viewer, billing_manager, or collaborator.
- `status` (String) `pending` while the invitation waits, `active` after the person accepts it.
- `team_ids` (Set of String) The team IDs of the person in the organization. While the membership is pending, the teams the person joins on acceptance.
